entries.title: Ask in chat replaces Dig deeper
entries.body: Dig deeper has gone from Glossary and Citations entries, the cards that appear when you point at a term or a cited work, Skim's term chip and the comment box. On your own articles, those cards and Skim's chip gain Ask in chat in its place, as do open ideas in Ideas. A conversation started from Glossary, Citations, Ideas or Debate shows a way back that opens that mode at the item it came from. Dig deeper answers you kept are still shown.

entries.title: Guide greets you, and works with Live
entries.body: An empty Guide conversation in Chat starts with a greeting instead of a separate form: it repeats the reason you gave for reading, or asks for one, and a short answer can be kept as that reason. Guide also works with Live, the spoken conversation, and on your own articles a Guide command in the command bar opens it without sending anything.

entries.title: Skim adds a cue only when it helps
entries.body: New Skim routes give a cue, the short line beside a quote, only when it adds what the quote lacks: what a reference points to, the question it settles, or why it matters. Existing routes keep theirs until re-planned. Cues are smaller and explain themselves when you point at one, and the current stop has one unbroken bar.

entries.title: Sharing is clearer while an article is added
entries.body: While an article is being added, its sharing section says it stays private unless you choose, offers a private link first, and asks you to confirm before making it public. The public tick box used to look ticked while still asking, though nothing was shared. The page no longer says your text was sent before the request is accepted.

entries.title: Skim's profile notice can be closed
entries.body: On your own articles, the Skim notice saying a route was planned before your profile last changed has a close button, so you can keep the route without planning it again. The notice comes back if the route is re-planned or your profile changes again.

entries.title: Live no longer sees hidden button text
entries.body: When you carried a typed conversation on out loud with Live, the earlier replies handed to the voice still held the hidden text that draws their buttons, which the voice could pick up and imitate. That hidden text is left out.
